90' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
